verdict.rationale: Auth0's pricing page lists 'SCIM' as a feature, confirming the capability exists, but there is no documentation in the evidence pack describing how SCIM user/group sync works, how deprovisioning in the IdP propagates to revoke app access, or any hands-on validation of this flow. Missing for 10: detailed SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning docs, explanation of access revocation behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
